newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga on Oslo Bourse observation list.
newsitem.headline: Saga on Oslo Bourse observation list.

text.p: Norway's Saga Petroleum ASA asked on Tuesday to be placed on the observation list on the Oslo Bourse in view of talks with Kuwait Petroleum Company on the possible purchase of KP North Sea Holding Ltd, or Santa Fe, a bourse statement said.
Saga said it had made a similar request to the New York Stock Exchange.
"Saga underlines that no agreement has been reached between the two parties and that it cannot at the present time say when the matter will be settled," the statement said.
The Financial Times on Saturday said there was market talk that British-based Santa Fe had been sold for over one billion sterling to Saga.
But Oslo financial daily Dagens Naeringsliv said on Tuesday it believed no deal had been made yet and that Saga and Conoco were apparently in the final bidding round for Santa Fe.
